_comment: Gather sessions for the step-2 shadow proof. Three shapes on purpose:
a bare-handed early node (no tool, tool_carry column absent -> null, so the
delta must NOT carry tool_carry), a tooled mid node whose interval does not
divide the 10 s cadence (4000 ms -> the remainder MUST be carried, not
forfeited), and a mining session that already holds a tool_carry the server
owns. Every id is validated against src/data on load by loadGatherSessions.
No real user ids: these uuids are zero-prefixed and match no account.

sessions.name: bare-handed woodcutter, normal tree, no tool carry column
tooled woodcutter, oak tree (4000 ms vs a 10 s cadence)
miner on iron, tool carry already held by the server
